# README preview assets

The README cover uses the app's committed overview screenshot. Marketing artwork now lives in the separate [Subloom-Landing](https://github.com/Baltii/Subloom-Landing) repository.

`overview-light.png` shows the responsive web export on an isolated local origin, captured on 22 October 2026 with the default green accent and light appearance. Subscription names, prices, and dates are illustrative records entered through the normal app UI; they are not provider offers or personal financial data.

The compact dark transaction screenshot is reused from `transactions-mobile.jpg`. It also uses illustrative data and demonstrates web responsiveness, not native-device certification.
